{"children": [
{"start":"spya-qarmqe","title":"The Cabin-Table","gist":"Ahab's officers and harpooneers eat in rigid class order revealing shipboard hierarchy.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 34. The Cabin-Table.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-xggrr9","title":"The Mast-Head","gist":"Ishmael describes mast-head watch duty and confesses his own dreamy, inattentive philosophizing aloft.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 35. The Mast-Head.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-fc3t6e","title":"The Quarter-Deck","gist":"Ahab nails the gold doubloon to the mast and binds the crew by oath to hunt Moby Dick.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 36. The Quarter-Deck.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-q68tv4","title":"Sunset","gist":"Alone at sunset, Ahab confesses his fixed, iron-willed purpose in soliloquy.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 37. Sunset.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-ws4hp3","title":"Dusk","gist":"Starbuck broods at the mainmast, feeling trapped yet unable to resist Ahab's mad purpose.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 38. Dusk.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-ea6tpn","title":"First Night-Watch","gist":"Stubb laughs off his unease with the old man's madness, treating fate as a joke.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 39. First Night-Watch.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-cbdxmt","title":"Midnight, Forecastle","gist":"The multinational crew sings, dances, and nearly brawls before a squall scatters them, foreshadowing dread of the white whale.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 40. Midnight, Forecastle.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-mpgpt3","title":"Moby Dick","gist":"Ishmael recounts the White Whale's legendary ferocity and traces how Ahab's mutilation curdled into monomania.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 41. Moby Dick.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-scwmuk","title":"The Whiteness of the Whale","gist":"Ishmael meditates on why whiteness itself, more than any other quality, makes the whale so terrifying.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 42. The Whiteness of the Whale.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-b05bnq","title":"Hark!","gist":"Night watchmen whisper about mysterious coughing sounds coming from below deck.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 43. Hark!","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-ufx069","title":"The Chart","gist":"Ahab studies charts and currents nightly, calculating where and when to intercept Moby Dick.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 44. The Chart.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-y7jx4m","title":"The Affidavit","gist":"Ishmael marshals real-world testimony and shipwrecks to argue the White Whale's malice is plausible fact, not fable.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 45. The Affidavit.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-mqq8fj","title":"Surmises","gist":"Ahab calculatingly maintains ordinary whaling business and crew morale as cover and support for his private vengeance.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 46. Surmises.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-srwdnq","title":"The Mat-Maker","gist":"While weaving a mat with Queequeg, Ishmael muses on fate and chance just before whales are sighted.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 47. The Mat-Maker.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-j36zfa","title":"The First Lowering","gist":"Ahab's secret boat crew led by Fedallah is revealed as the Pequod's boats chase whales into a dangerous squall.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 48. The First Lowering.","needsDeeper":true,"why":"Multiple distinct movements: crew reveal, chase, squall, rescue."},
{"start":"spya-r95wvw","title":"The Hyena","gist":"Shaken by the squall, Ishmael adopts a gallows-humor philosophy and jokingly makes his will.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 49. The Hyena.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-s7z4x2","title":"Ahab's Boat and Crew. Fedallah.","gist":"The narrator explains why Ahab secretly outfitted his own boat and crew, and dwells on Fedallah's uncanny mystery.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 50. Ahab's Boat and Crew. Fedallah.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-td0rbx","title":"The Spirit-Spout","gist":"A ghostly, unreachable spout lures the Pequod through calm seas and then a violent Cape storm.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 51. The Spirit-Spout.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-da0kz0","title":"The Albatross","gist":"The weathered whaler Goney passes by, and Ahab's hail about the White Whale goes unanswered as he presses on round the world.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 52. The Albatross.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""},
{"start":"spya-kxhuy2","title":"The Gam","gist":"Ishmael explains the whaling custom of the 'gam,' a sociable meeting between ships at sea.","sourceHeading":"CHAPTER 53. The Gam.","needsDeeper":false,"why":""}
]}
